AN348
Space, Place and Culture
0.5 Credit
Hours per week:
Lecture/Discussion: 3
This
course
introduces anthropological approaches to studying the experience, imagination, and social production of space and place. It will consider topics such as storytelling, memory, urban planning, the politics of nature, and the reconfiguration of space by transnational forces, in a variety of cultural and historical settings.
Additional Course Information
Prerequisites
Registration Status: Year 3 or Year 4
